title: finalize() reserves only 64 B; batching AEAD providers silently fail
description: Trigger: any GCM or batching cipher provider that accumulates all data in update() with outlen=0 and flushes everything in finalize(). ioctl_finalize() calls outbuf_grow(state, CRYPTO2DEV_HASH_MAXLEN=64) reserving only 64 bytes, then hard-errors if produced > 64. The provider API explicitly permits finalize() to produce the full ciphertext (GCM: encrypted payload). Bad outcome: for any payload > 64 bytes with a batching GCM provider, -EOVERFLOW or -EIO is returned and state->error is set, making the session permanently dead.
